_meta.description: Harness concept ontology — lightweight structured vocabulary for cross-referencing memory items. Not RDF/OWL; intentionally simple JSON for zero-dep search.
_meta.usage: Read by ontology-search.mjs. Extend by adding concepts to the array. 'related' uses concept ids. 'memoryHints' are substrings to find relevant lessons/briefs.

concepts.label: Stage Machine
concepts.definition: The 7-stage harness workflow: Understand → Architect → Architect-Challenge → Implement → Review Breadth → Review Depth → Feedback.

concepts.label: Convergence Loop
concepts.definition: A bounded iterative loop that runs checks and invokes an agent until all checks pass or maxIterations is reached.

concepts.label: Routing Profile
concepts.definition: A named harness configuration that maps a task intent to a specific stage sequence and model tier.

concepts.label: Model Tier
concepts.definition: One of five capability levels: ultra-reasoning, high-reasoning, balanced-coding, fast-execution, universal-fallback.

concepts.label: Skill-Model Mapping
concepts.definition: Per-skill primary model + fallback chain defined in harness.config.json skillModelMapping.

concepts.label: Stage State
concepts.definition: Live JSON record of the currently active run: loop name, stage, iteration, approval status. Written by stage-state.mjs.

concepts.label: Approval Workflow
concepts.definition: Human-in-the-loop gate: a loop marks approval.required=true and pauses until a decision (approved/rejected) is written to approvals.jsonl.

concepts.label: Control Panel
concepts.definition: Browser UI at /control served from report-server.mjs. Shows live stage state via SSE and exposes approve/reject buttons.

concepts.label: SSE Stream
concepts.definition: Server-Sent Events endpoint at /sse/state that pushes stage-state.json changes to the browser every 2 s.

concepts.label: Memory System
concepts.definition: Persistent harness knowledge: lessons (how-tos), briefs (architecture decisions), radar (technique evaluations), understanding (codebase analysis).

concepts.label: Vector Search
concepts.definition: Semantic search over memory and filesystem using Ollama embeddings (nomic-embed-text). Supports fs scope for arbitrary file trees.

concepts.label: Ontology
concepts.definition: Lightweight concept taxonomy in .github/harness/memory/ontology/core.json. Enables cross-referencing between memory items and structured concept navigation.

concepts.label: File Search
concepts.definition: Filesystem-first semantic search CLI (file-search.mjs). Indexes and searches arbitrary directory trees using Ollama embeddings.

concepts.label: Document Ingestion
concepts.definition: Text extraction from PDF, DOCX, XLSX, and images via system tools (pdftotext, python-docx, openpyxl, libreoffice) and Ollama vision models.

concepts.label: MCP Server
concepts.definition: stdio MCP server exposing 24 harness tools (graph, memory, vector, routing, catalog) to AI clients.

concepts.label: HTTP Adapter
concepts.definition: REST server at port 8100 exposing all MCP tools as HTTP endpoints with auto-generated OpenAPI 3.0 schema and API key auth.

concepts.label: Teams Notifier
concepts.definition: Adaptive Card generator + Teams webhook poster for loop events: stage-complete, approval-needed, error-alert.

concepts.label: Document Verifier
concepts.definition: Readability and structure checker for prose documents. Uses Flesch-Kincaid Reading Ease, required sections, and word count thresholds.

concepts.label: Doc Workflow Mode
concepts.definition: Harness mode (mode=doc-workflow) that runs the doc-verifier convergence loop to improve document quality iteratively.

concepts.label: Harness Proxy
concepts.definition: OpenAI/Ollama-compatible HTTP proxy (port 11435) that intercepts chat requests, injects harness stage plans, and streams responses from Ollama.

concepts.label: Open WebUI
concepts.definition: ChatGPT-like browser interface for Ollama. Configured to route through harness-proxy so every chat message receives harness stage-plan injection.
